# Raqeem

> Raqeem (رقيم) is a school management platform for private schools and educational institutions. It helps authorized school teams manage daily operations including student records, attendance, finance, timetables, communication, and administrative workflows.

## Official website

- https://www.raqeem.ma/
- Arabic: https://www.raqeem.ma/ar
- French: https://www.raqeem.ma/fr
- English: https://www.raqeem.ma/en
- Spanish: https://www.raqeem.ma/es

## Key resources

- Guides: https://www.raqeem.ma/ar/guides
- FAQ: https://www.raqeem.ma/ar/faq

- Privacy center: https://www.raqeem.ma/ar/privacy-center

## Important clarification

Raqeem can prepare supported files for an authorized user to review and upload to Massar. This does not imply a permanent direct connection, official synchronization, or endorsement by Massar unless Raqeem explicitly announces such an integration.
